glosses: etwas auf der Grundlage von Axiomen festlegen

translations.source_sense_description: transitiv: etwas zu einem Axiom erklären
transitiv: etwas zu einem Axiom erklären

glosses: To establish a set of axioms that describe or govern certain phenomena

examples.text: For toposes were invented by Grothendieck in the sixties for specific purposes in algebraic geometry and algebraic topology. Later on, Lawvere and Tierney [11] axiomatized the notion of an elementary topos with the goal of providing an appropriate foundation for differential geometry.

translations.source_sense_description: transitiv: etwas zu einem Axiom erklären

examples.text: Des écritures mathématiques se font axiomatiser, c’est-à-dire re-stratifier, re-sémiotiser ; des flux matériels se font rephysicaliser.
